fusions.name: Picked Out
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Look Over There
fusions.desc: A pointing gesture through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 arcane damage, stuns everything in it for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Blink and Missed
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Watched Long Enough
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
